# Add a Robot: code map

<!-- generated by APP_MAKER/standard/app_map.py · 2026-11-27 · code 8b58eed9292f · regenerate after every change -->

**Read this first, then open only the files it points to.** Line numbers are where definitions start; read
around them with an offset instead of whole files.

**What it is:** Build a camera robot on wheels with a Raspberry Pi, an Arduino or an old phone, install it with one command, and drive it live from any browser over WebRTC.
**Live:** https://addarobot.com · **Repo:** github.com/arkulinskis/robo-presence · **Layout:** native Anvil Forms · **Deploy:** master
**Guide** (workflow, design rules, product knowledge): `robo-presence/.claude/skills/robopresence/SKILL.md`

## How to change it

- **New page**: copy a similar `client_code/Pages/<Name>/` (form_template.html + __init__.py), register it in
  `client_code/router.py` (`PAGES`, `_form()`, and `NAV` for the menu). Address = `#name/arg`.
- **New list**: a RepeatingPanel in the page template + `client_code/Items/<Name>/`. **Dialog**: `client_code/Dialogs/<Name>/` opened with `alert(...)`.
- **New server function**: `@anvil.server.callable` in the matching `server_code` module (see *Server*), called with `state.call("name", ...)`.
- **New table/column**: `anvil.yaml` → `db_schema` (the user accepts Anvil's Schema Mismatch alert); update the server-test mock.
- **Drawing/media/canvas**: a JavaScript engine in `theme/assets/` wrapped by a Python module or a `Components/` form.
- **Styles**: `theme/assets/app.css` (colour tokens at the top; rules in APP_MAKER/design/README.md).
- **Check**: `python tools/check.py` → ALL CHECKS PASSED; UI: `python -I tools/ui_test.py` (Docker Desktop running).
- **Deploy**: commit as arkulinskis (+ Co-Authored-By) and `git push` (master unless apps.json says branch-first).
- **Footer** must keep: Submit feedback (Prepsto), Privacy & Terms, Contact developer (arkvital.com), Parent company (addanapp.com).
- **After any change**: `python -I C:/Users/arkvi/Documents/CLAUDE/APP_MAKER/standard/app_map.py robopresence` refreshes this map.

## Notes

<!-- NOTES: hand-written, kept when the map is regenerated -->
- **Engines stay JavaScript** (theme/assets): rp-core.js (robot picture, lamps, gauges, copy/download), rp-sim.js
  (RobotCore + 3D garage), rp-link.js (WebRTC pilot link + RobotHost), rp-cockpit.js (driving screen; `RP.openCockpit`
  at the end takes plain JSON options), rp-builder.js (part cards, pin map, Arduino sketch; `RP.partsEditor` +
  `RP.moveToBoard` at the end are Forms-version additions), rp-bot.js (Web Serial Arduino + `RP.BotRunner`, the old
  bot page's start/stop). rp-kit.js = the old `window.UI` helpers the engines use; their server calls go through
  `window.RP_BRIDGE` and toasts/confirms through `RP.host` (client_code/rp.py `setup()`).
- **Protocol in three places** still: server_code/Parts.py, robot/robopresence/parts.py, rp-builder.js (+ cockpit).
  `rp.split` / `rp.pilot_gets` in client_code/rp.py are Python ports of RP.split / whatPilotGets (keep in step).
- Robot page = Pages/Robot (hero, tabs, 3 s robot_status poll via window.setInterval, cleared in `leave()`) + one Form
  per tab in client_code/Tabs; tabs call `page.set_robot(robot)` after an action. router.show() calls `leave()`.
- Pages/Drive has no layout (full-screen cockpit) and `waits = True`: Components/Cockpit sets UI_READY when connected.
- The validator types `self.x = None` as None for good: use `rp.loose(None)`. dom_nodes with built names go through
  a `_nodes()` helper.
- Anvil's template parser strips leading spaces inside `<pre>`: the landing/guide code blocks use `&nbsp;`.
- Tests: `python tools/check.py`; `python -I tools/ui_test.py` = tools/ui/smoke.js (every address, guest/member/admin,
  1280 + 390 px, incl. a guest pass). Real-robot and Web Serial paths can't run here (old bot_e2e.py lives in the
  retired source folder).
- **Push-to-talk** (2026-11-18): config `camera.talk` (default on; Parts.clean, Tabs/Parts checkbox `cam_talk`); the robot
  reports `camera.talk` in its manifest only if it can play sound (robot.py: `speaker.available()` = aplay exists; browser
  robots: rp-bot.js sets `core.camera`). Old robot code reports nothing -> no Talk button. Pilot side: rp-link.js adds one
  audio transceiver (sendonly / sendrecv) with no track; `link.talk(on)` asks for the mic on the first press and
  `replaceTrack`s it in (no renegotiation), then toggles `track.enabled`. Cockpit: `[data-talk]` button, T key,
  `[data-onair]` badge, `talkDown/talkUp` on window.RP_COCKPIT. Robot: peer.py `on("track")` -> speaker.play (aplay,
  48 kHz mono s16) or speaker.drain for viewers. Browser robot: RobotHost `pc.ontrack` -> an `<audio>` element.
  Test: `node tools/ui/talk_e2e.mjs http://localhost:<port>` (two tabs, Chrome's fake mic) after `tools/ui_test.py`.
- Pages/Bot calls `RP.BotRunner(...)` from Python without `new`: the constructor guards for it (it was broken before 2026-11-18).
- **House rules** (2026-11-20): server_code/HouseRules.py, optional column `robots.house_rules` (read/written through
  guards, so the app runs before the schema is accepted). Visiting hours (days + from/to in the owner's tz name, with a
  fixed-offset fallback) and a privacy pause. `blocked(r, role)` is checked in Drive.drive_open/drive_offer (owners
  bypass) and Sharing.pass_info; BotApi.bot_poll ends visitors' sessions while closed (robots drop them through the
  existing `ended` list: no robot code change). UI: Tabs/Sharing card, Pages/Bot Privacy card, Pages/Drive `_closed`,
  RobotCard chip. Door chime: `RP.chime()` (rp-core.js) on connect in RobotHost, `chime` option from Pages/Bot.
- **Connection check** `#check` (Pages/Check + Items/CheckRow): `RP.netCheck` lives in rp-link.js (no new asset);
  one RTCPeerConnection against all STUN servers (several srflx ports for one local socket = symmetric NAT), then a
  relay-only gather. Drive.net_check_info gives TURN logins to signed-in people only; guests read the cached status.
- **Build sheets** `#builds` / `#build/<id>` (Pages/Builds, Pages/Build, Items/BuildCard, server_code/Builds.py):
  optional column `robots.build_sheet` read via Robots.sheet_of; showroom robots are always public. Owner switch in
  Tabs/Overview. build_clone uses Robots.new_robot_row (create_robot's body). `#drive/sim/<id>` falls back to
  build_get for anyone.
- **Lag guard** (rp-cockpit.js, live only): `guard` state; checkLag in statTimer (RTT > 300 ms or < 8 fps for 3 s ->
  gear 1, 5 good seconds -> back), checkFrozen in sendTimer (requestVideoFrameCallback, or totalVideoFrames; 1.5 s
  frozen while moving -> one `stop`, wheels held at 0 until frames return). G toggles (UI.store `lagguard`).

## Data tables (`anvil.yaml` db_schema)

- **app_settings**: key:str, value:obj · used in common, Lifetime
- **error_log**: when:dt, source:str, kind:str, message:str, traceback:str, page:str, session:str, user→users
- **events**: robot→robots, kind:str, text:str, at:dt, is_demo:bool · used in BotApi, DemoData, Robots
- **feedback**: user→users, name:str, email:str, kind:str, message:str, context:obj, status:str, note:str, created:dt · used in Feedback
- **lifetime_purchases**: user→users, email:str, status:str, amount:num, currency:str, session:str, payment_intent:str, created:dt, updated:dt, note:str · used in Lifetime
- **passes**: robot→robots, token_hash:str, label:str, role:str, expires:dt, created:dt, last_used:dt, uses:num, is_demo:bool · used in DemoData, Robots, Sharing
- **robots**: owner→users, name:str, color:str, notes:str, preset:str, config:obj, config_rev:num, manifest:obj, info:obj, telemetry:obj, last_seen:dt, wanted_until:dt, token_hash:str, tab_token_hash:str, install_code:str, install_code_expires:dt, paired_at:dt, created:dt, is_demo:bool, house_rules:obj, build_sheet:obj · used in Admin, BotApi, Builds, DemoData, Drive, Robots
- **sessions**: robot→robots, user→users, guest_pass→passes, pilot_name:str, role:str, secret_hash:str, offer:str, answer:str, state:str, created:dt, answered_at:dt, ended_at:dt, stats:obj, is_demo:bool · used in Admin, BotApi, DemoData, Drive, HouseRules, Robots, Sharing
- **shares**: robot→robots, email:str, user→users, role:str, created:dt, is_demo:bool · used in DemoData, Robots, Sharing
- **users**: email:str, enabled:bool, last_login:dt, password_hash:str, n_password_failures:num, confirmed_email:bool, signed_up:dt, display_name:str, is_admin:bool, is_demo:bool, last_seen:dt, legal_version:str, legal_accepted_at:dt, legal_source:str · used in Admin, DemoData, Lifetime, Sharing

## Tools

- `tools/assets.py`: Refresh the theme assets' cache-busting hashes in anvil.yaml (and icons.css).
- `tools/build_icons.py`: Write theme/assets/icons.css from the icon table in theme/assets/lh-kit.js (UI.ICONS).
- `tools/check.py`: Everything that must pass before pushing. Ends with ALL CHECKS PASSED.
- `tools/make_icons.py`: Make the PNG app icons from theme/assets/icon.svg (headless Chrome draws them).
- `tools/session_test.py`: Expired-session test: the app must reload quietly (same page, still signed in, typed text kept) ins…
- `tools/ui_test.py`: Run the app for real in the open-source Anvil App Server (Docker) and drive it with headless Chrome.
